summary: Both design units are implementable and their contracts (errors, boundaries, half-up integer average formula) are precise; the formula (total*20+count)//(2*count)/10 was checked for 2.25->2.3 and 1/3->0.3. Unit tests TEST-001..015 carry concrete expected values and can detect rounding, tie-break, error-propagation and exit-code defects; TEST-016/017 cover IF-001 including the error path; system tests TEST-018..021 cover every acceptance criterion. DESIGN-001 now lives in src/scorepipe/summary.py, consistent with ARCH-001 location.

checklist.note: summarize and main are fully described; module paths match ARCH locations.
pre/postconditions, errors and boundaries given; parser TypeError/ValueError propagation matches parser.py.
Banker's rounding distinguished in TEST-006; tie-break TEST-007; stdout/stderr/exit code asserted in TEST-009..015.
IF-001 normal (TEST-016 incl. subprocess) and error path (TEST-017) with real parser.

checklist.item: System specs cover every acceptance criterion
checklist.note: AC-001-1..3, 002-1..2, 003-1, 004-1..2, 005-1..2 all mapped; REQ-006 has no ACs (constraint, covered by TEST-001 injection).

findings.description: parser.isdigit() accepts non-ASCII digit characters (e.g. superscripts) for which int() would raise ValueError without a 'line N' prefix; parser is out of scope (REQ-006) and undefined by requirements.
